---
title: "EMT Report"
params:
  config: "configs/mydataset.yml"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    embed-resources: true
    fig-dpi: 96
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggprism)
  library(knitr)
})
for (f in list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) source(f)

cfg <- load_emt_config(params$config)
out_dir    <- cfg$output_dir
panel_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "panels")
sweep_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "all-metrics")
stats_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "stats")
sz <- cfg$panel_sizes
no_legend <- theme(legend.position = "none")

# Collect import warnings so they show up in the report instead of the console
import_warnings <- character()
collect <- function(expr) withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = function(w) {
  import_warnings <<- c(import_warnings, conditionMessage(w))
  invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
})

batch_sheet <- read_batch_sheet(cfg$batch_csv)
excluded    <- attr(batch_sheet, "excluded")
metric_batches <- resolve_batches(cfg$metric_batches, batch_sheet$batch)
trace_batches  <- resolve_batches(cfg$trace_batches,  batch_sheet$batch)
has <- function(a) any(batch_sheet$analysis == a)

traces75 <- if (has("75hz")) collect(import_traces(cfg$batch_csv, "75hz", cfg$conditions, trace_batches))
m75      <- if (has("75hz")) collect(import_metrics(cfg$batch_csv, "75hz", cfg$conditions, metric_batches))
mff      <- if (has("ff")) collect(import_metrics(cfg$batch_csv, "ff", cfg$conditions, metric_batches))
fat_tr   <- if (has("fatigue")) collect(import_traces(cfg$batch_csv, "fatigue", cfg$conditions, trace_batches))
mfat     <- if (has("fatigue")) collect(import_metrics(cfg$batch_csv, "fatigue", cfg$conditions, metric_batches))

import_warnings <- unique(import_warnings)

sp_args <- list(colors = cfg$colors, days_max = cfg$days_max,
                batches = metric_batches, labels = cfg$labels, seed = cfg$seed)
```

**Dataset:** `r cfg$name` · **Config:** `r params$config` · **Rendered:** `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")`

## Data summary

```{r summary-table}
tibble(
  Setting = c("Batch CSV", "Days shown", "Metric batches (panels C+, sweep, stats)",
              "Trace batches (panels A/B, fatigue curves)", "Conditions (first = stats reference)",
              "Statistics unit", "Output folder"),
  Value = c(cfg$batch_csv,
            if (is.finite(cfg$days_max)) paste("≤", cfg$days_max) else "all",
            paste(metric_batches, collapse = ", "),
            paste(trace_batches, collapse = ", "),
            paste(names(cfg$conditions), collapse = ", "),
            paste0(cfg$stats$unit, if (isTRUE(cfg$stats$paired)) " (paired)" else "",
                   ", p adjusted: ", cfg$stats$p_adjust, " within metric"),
            normalizePath(out_dir, mustWork = FALSE))
) |> kable()
```

```{r batches-not-used}
#| results: asis
not_used <- setdiff(unique(batch_sheet$batch), metric_batches)
if (length(not_used)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nBatch(es) **", paste(not_used, collapse = ", "),
      "** are not excluded in the batch CSV but are not in `metric_batches`, so they are left out of the metric panels and statistics.\n:::\n", sep = "")
}
if (nrow(excluded)) {
  cat("\n**Excluded in the batch CSV:**\n\n")
  print(kable(excluded |> select(any_of(c("batch", "plate", "analysis", "directory")))))
}
qc <- bind_rows(qc_nonpositive_force(m75, "75hz"),
                qc_nonpositive_force(mff, "ff"),
                qc_nonpositive_force(mfat, "fatigue"))
if (nrow(qc)) {
  cat("\n::: {.callout-warning}\n## QC: wells with zero or negative active force\n\n",
      "Usually means peak detection failed upstream for that file. Normalized metrics for these wells (e.g. FF Normalized) are not meaningful. They are **not** removed automatically; re-run the analysis or exclude the batch.\n\n", sep = "")
  print(kable(qc))
  cat("\n:::\n")
}
if (length(import_warnings)) {
  cat("\n::: {.callout-warning}\n## Import warnings\n\n",
      paste0("- ", import_warnings, collapse = "\n"), "\n:::\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Figure panels

PNGs (no legends, sized for figure assembly) are saved to ``r panel_dir``.

```{r kinetics-prep}
kin <- if (!is.null(traces75)) prep_kinetics_traces(
  traces75, cfg$kinetics$stim_time_s, cfg$kinetics$window_s,
  cfg$kinetics$baseline_s, cfg$days_max)
```

### A. Normalized force (75 Hz, stim at `r cfg$kinetics$stim_time_s` s)

```{r panel-a}
#| fig-width: !expr cfg$panel_sizes$traces[1]
#| fig-height: !expr cfg$panel_sizes$traces[2] + 0.6
if (!is.null(kin)) {
  p <- kinetics_trace_plot(kin, "normalized", cfg$colors, cfg$kinetics$window_s)
  save_panel(p + no_legend, "A_normalized_force", sz$traces, panel_dir)
  p + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```


### `r paste(LETTERS[2 + seq_along(cfg$kinetics_metrics)], collapse = "–")`. Kinetics metrics

```{r panels-kinetics-metrics}
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-width: !expr cfg$panel_sizes$metric[1] + 1.5
#| fig-height: !expr cfg$panel_sizes$metric[2]
if (!is.null(m75)) {
  km <- cfg$kinetics_metrics
  for (i in seq_along(km)) {
    p <- do.call(metric_superplot, c(list(m75, names(km)[i], y_label = km[[i]]), sp_args))
    save_panel(p + no_legend, paste0(LETTERS[2 + i], "_", names(km)[i]), sz$metric, panel_dir)
    print(p + ggtitle(names(km)[i]))
  }
}
next_letter <- LETTERS[3 + length(cfg$kinetics_metrics)]
```

### `r next_letter`. Force-frequency: `r cfg$ff_metric$name`

```{r panel-ff}
#| fig-width: !expr cfg$panel_sizes$ff[1]
#| fig-height: !expr cfg$panel_sizes$ff[2] + 0.8
if (!is.null(mff)) {
  p <- do.call(ff_superplot, c(list(mff, cfg$ff_metric$name, y_label = cfg$ff_metric$label), sp_args))
  save_panel(p + no_legend, paste0(next_letter, "_FF_", cfg$ff_metric$name), sz$ff, panel_dir)
  p + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

## Statistics

```{r stats}
st <- cfg$stats
run_stats <- function(m, by) {
  if (is.null(m)) return(NULL)
  m |>
    filter(day <= cfg$days_max) |>
    compare_conditions(by = by, unit = st$unit, paired = isTRUE(st$paired),
                       p_adjust = st$p_adjust)
}
stats <- list(
  `75hz`  = run_stats(m75, "day"),
  ff      = run_stats(mff, c("day", "Hz")),
  fatigue = run_stats(mfat, "day")
) |> compact()

dir.create(stats_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
iwalk(stats, \(s, nm) write_csv(s, file.path(stats_dir, paste0("stats_", nm, ".csv"))))

fmt_stats <- function(s) {
  s |> mutate(across(c(mean_ref, mean_cmp, difference), \(x) signif(x, 3)),
              across(c(p_value, p_adj), \(x) signif(x, 2)))
}
```

Each condition is compared with **`r names(cfg$conditions)[1]`** by `r if (isTRUE(cfg$stats$paired)) "paired" else "Welch"` t-test, separately for each day`r if (!is.null(mff)) " (and each frequency for force-frequency)"`. With `unit: batch`, wells are averaged within each batch first, so *n* is the number of batches. With `unit: well`, wells are treated as independent, which overstates significance. p-values are adjusted (`r cfg$stats$p_adjust`) within each metric. Full tables are saved as CSVs in ``r stats_dir``.

### Panel metrics

```{r stats-panel}
panel_rows <- list(
  if (!is.null(stats$`75hz`)) filter(stats$`75hz`, metric %in% names(cfg$kinetics_metrics)),
  if (!is.null(stats$ff)) filter(stats$ff, metric == cfg$ff_metric$name) |>
    group_by(metric, comparison, day) |> slice_min(p_adj, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> ungroup() |>
    mutate(metric = paste0(metric, " (lowest-p Hz: ", Hz, ")")) |> select(-Hz),
  if (!is.null(stats$fatigue)) filter(stats$fatigue, metric %in% names(cfg$fatigue_metrics))
) |> compact() |> bind_rows()
if (nrow(panel_rows)) {
  panel_rows |> fmt_stats() |>
    select(metric, day, comparison, n_ref, n_cmp, mean_ref, mean_cmp, difference, p_value, p_adj, note) |>
    kable()
}
```

### All metrics

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r stats-dt-fn}
stats_dt <- function(s) {
  if (is.null(s)) return(invisible(NULL))
  DT::datatable(fmt_stats(s), filter = "top", rownames = FALSE,
                options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE))
}
```

#### 75 Hz kinetics

```{r stats-75}
stats_dt(stats$`75hz`)
```

#### Force-frequency

```{r stats-ff}
stats_dt(stats$ff)
```

#### Fatigue

```{r stats-fatigue}

```

## All-metrics sweep

```{r sweep-setup}
#| results: asis
do_sweep <- isTRUE(cfg$sweep)
if (do_sweep) {
  cat("Every metric in every analysis, for days ≤ ", cfg$days_max, " and batches ",
      paste(metric_batches, collapse = ", "), ". PNGs are saved to `", sweep_dir, "`.\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("Sweep disabled in config (`sweep: false`).\n")
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r sweep-75hz}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.5
if (do_sweep && !is.null(m75)) {
  cat("\n\n#### 75 Hz kinetics\n\n")
  for (m in unique(m75$metric)) {
    p <- do.call(metric_superplot, c(list(m75, m), sp_args)) + ggtitle(m)
    save_panel(p, paste0("75hz_", m), sz$sweep, sweep_dir, dpi = 150)
    print(p); cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r sweep-ff}

}
```
